label: Syria is the red line, Iran was the unwanted stepchild
description: That when Iran was struck the region did not much care, calling Iran an unwanted stepchild, but that when Syria is touched they will all come to its defence, with Turkey leading it.
aliases: Iran was an unwanted stepchild
when Syria is messed with in the days ahead, they will all come to the defense

label: Stretched too thin: who will you save?
description: A taunt heard in the spirit addressed to the American president: who will you save, one, two, three, you cannot do all of them, we stretch you too thin for the enemy within, we have infiltrated your land. Given alongside an alliance of Kim, Putin and Turkey seen planting trees together.
aliases: Who will you save? We stretch you too thin
You can't do all of them
We have infiltrated your land

label: Women in China with painted faces and kimono dresses
description: Women seen in China with painted faces wearing kimono dresses, which he says was symbolic of things happening, given alongside the web being woven across Europe. He offers no interpretation.
aliases: these women in China that had painted faces
that had kimono dresses on

label: Something about a plant on the Mississippi
description: Canada seen with the phrase in the bus repeated, then a statement that it is about a plant on the Mississippi and an instruction to listen. No further detail is given.
aliases: It's about a plant on the Mississippi
You must listen

label: A B-2 bomber coming in low over Europe
description: Seen while flying in low in the spirit over Europe alongside the Ukrainian president, a plane and a storm: a B-2 bomber coming in low.
aliases: I see a B2 bomber coming in low
I see a storm over Europe still

label: The president falling asleep and his fitness questioned
description: Footage of the president appearing to fall asleep at a basketball game, with commentators saying he is not fit for office, which he contrasts with the president's own mockery of his predecessor. Given alongside his warning that the twenty fifth amendment is what they are after.
aliases: fallen asleep at the New York Knicks game
he made fun of Sleepy Joe and now he's not fit for office

label: The rioting spreads from France to the United Kingdom
description: Protests and burning seen spreading from France into the United Kingdom over immigration, with buses being burned.
aliases: It's spreading to United Kingdom now
So they're burning the buses

label: Blacked out faces and an underground network at the rallies
description: Seen across every place holding the No Kings rally: faces that are blacked out, which he says is a representation rather than literal hoodies, and an underground network behind them.
aliases: I see faces that are blacked out
It's an underground network
concerning the no kings rally

label: A great distraction coming on the clock
description: A clock seen with a great distraction coming on it, given alongside a European song about whatever will be will be and the line the future is ours.
aliases: There's a great distraction coming on the clock
Whatever will be will be
The future is ours
